استكملن (form X)
# اِسْتَكْمَلْنَ (istakmalna) /is.tak.mal.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَكْمَلَ (istakmala)
# اُسْتُكْمِلْنَ (ustukmilna) /us.tuk.mil.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَكْمَلَ (istakmala)
# اِسْتَكْمِلْنَ (istakmilna) /is.tak.mil.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَكْمَلَ (istakmala)
